name: Local Ambient Occlusion Adaptive Sampling
definition: A technique to improve LAO performance and reduce artifacts by adjusting sampling density along rays based on the resolution level (scale) of the volume block currently being sampled. It ensures features are not missed in low-resolution blocks while avoiding oversampling in high-resolution blocks.
summary: Local Ambient Occlusion Adaptive Sampling improves LAO performance by dynamically adjusting ray step length based on volume block resolution, preventing artifacts without oversampling.
